summary: Wake an agent seat when a queue move, a new run, or newly ready work changes its first eligible entry, including while the seat retains a claim. An unchanged head sends no additional queue-head wake.

schema.detail: Uses existing work wake messages and their idempotency keys.

rules.detail: Queue ordering and claim capacity are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Seats receive an existing work wake for a changed eligible queue head even while holding another claim. Held-seat notices neither reset fresh context nor consume claim-wake attempts; normal waking applies once the seat is free. The held claim is never released or reassigned.

recovery.detail: Older daemons retain the previous held-seat wake behavior.
